$comment: Classifies every custom property in foundation/ui/src/foundations/tokens.css for the design-system export. build.ts fails on an unclassified property. Type style values starting with -- resolve from tokens.css.

background.usage: Page background behind every surface. The product theme lifts it to white so dense work reads on one plane.

surface.usage: Fields, secondary buttons, dialogs and raised content.

surface-muted.usage: Quiet fills: neutral badges and notices, read-only fields, hover on quiet buttons, tabs and list rows.

foreground.usage: Body text and headings on background, surface and surface-muted (13:1).

muted.usage: Secondary text: captions, descriptions, kickers, placeholders, unselected tabs. Reads on background, surface and surface-muted (5.1:1 or more).

border.usage: Hairlines at the edge of a surface: panels, frames, tables, read-only fields, edge-strength dividers. Decorative, not a control edge.

border-subtle.reason: A color-mix() of border and surface; tokens.json cannot hold color-mix().

border-control.usage: Edge of an editable field (3.3:1 on surface). Mixed toward border for a secondary button's quieter edge.

border-raised.usage: Edge of a surface raised over content: popovers, menus, toasts.

action.usage: The one interactive colour: primary buttons, links, the selected tab rule, the brand mark. Text on background or surface (6.8:1).

action-hover.usage: Hover and press for primary buttons and links.

focus.usage: Focus outline: 2px solid, 2px offset. Fields swap it to danger while invalid.

action-subtle.usage: Focused secondary and quiet buttons, focused list rows and text selection. action text reads on it (6.4:1).

success.usage: Success text and icons on success-subtle (6.5:1 site, 6.0:1 product). Always with a word.

warning.usage: Warning and attention text on warning-subtle (5.6:1) or background.

danger.usage: Destructive buttons, field errors, failure text on danger-subtle (6.1:1).

overlay.reason: A color-mix() of foreground; tokens.json cannot hold color-mix().

popover-radius.usage: Corners of every popover: menus, select lists, pickers, calendars, reference popovers, tooltips.

space-1.usage: Label to field, badge gap, tight stacks.

space-2.usage: Gap between buttons, icon to label, a source and its passage.

space-3.usage: Control inline padding, notice padding, list row padding.

space-5.usage: Large button inline padding, roomy panels.

space-6.usage: Separating groups, such as a budget after a proposal; tab toolbar margin.

text-meta.reason: Type scale step; the type styles carry its size.

text-caption.reason: Type scale step; the type styles carry its size.

text-detail.reason: Type scale step; the type styles carry its size.

text-body.reason: Type scale step; the type styles carry its size.

text-reading.reason: Type scale step; the type styles carry its size.

leading-reading.reason: Type scale step; the type styles carry its size.

measure-reading.reason: A ch length, which tokens.json cannot hold.

text-section.reason: Type scale step; the type styles carry its size.

text-page.reason: Type scale step; the type styles carry its size.

text-page-compact.reason: Type scale step; the type styles carry its size.

text-display.reason: Type scale step; the type styles carry its size.

text-control.reason: Type scale step; the type styles carry its size.

text-label.reason: Type scale step; the type styles carry its size.

weight-regular.reason: Type weight step; the type styles carry its weight.

weight-medium.reason: Type weight step; the type styles carry its weight.

weight-heading.reason: Type weight step; the type styles carry its weight.

weight-emphasis.reason: Type weight step; the type styles carry its weight.

weight-brand.reason: The wordmark only; the type styles do not use it.

button-height.reason: Changes in the product theme, which slims buttons to 1.75rem for dense work.

button-quiet-inset.reason: A calc() of space-2 and the quiet button's border; outdents a leading quiet button so its text meets the content edge.

bar-height.usage: The application top bar, and the headers of panels beside it that line up with it.

target-touch.usage: Minimum control height on coarse pointers; large buttons.

motion-fast.reason: Duration; the format has no motion tokens.

motion-medium.reason: Duration; the format has no motion tokens.

popover-shadow.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips, the search palette.

extra.name: badge-radius
extra.usage: Badges and the section-count chip (written literally in badge.module.css and section-header.module.css).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Public site heroes. Source scales it fluidly: clamp(1.875rem, 4vw, 2.5rem).
styles.sample: Grant work, with the evidence in view

styles.name: page-compact
styles.usage: Page title in compact headers and below 600px.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above a page title, in muted.

styles.name: reading
styles.usage: Sustained reading: submissions, assessments, reasoning. Keep to a 65ch measure.
styles.sample: The project will train forty community health workers across three districts.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default interface copy, controls and labels on the site. The product theme sets body, control and label text in detail instead.

styles.name: detail
styles.usage: Dense work: interface and copy in the product, tabs, notices, supporting text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Field descriptions, errors, badges, metadata, in muted.
styles.sample: Owners can invite and remove members.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: The smallest step: kickers and tight metadata only.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Button and field-label text (body size, weight 500).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark 'merit', lowercase, beside the mark. Size follows its container.
